hurried: due dates on each tailor entry

hurried: add a note box to each job pls
fuller: I keep forgetting what I said to each company, so a note box on every job would help me remember. Old jobs can leave it blank, and the follow up reminder can stay as it is.

hurried: make it little coffee runs pls
fuller: 3 cups a day is still my goal and the streak is the thing I look at, so could the app be renamed Little Coffee runs? Keep the note box and the log run form as they are.

hurried: show days since last test pls
fuller: I check my blood sugar at odd times and forget when the last test was, so could a days since the last entry line sit under the readings? The fasting, after meal and bedtime choices can stay the same.
The weekly limit and the count of seizures are the things I need to see, so could the whole look change to ink? Keep the log seizure button and the list as they are.

hurried: bp note box on each reading pls
fuller: The layout of the readings is clear, and I want a little note box on each one for what I was doing. The old readings can stay blank, and the high reading warning stays as it is.

hurried: number the class list instead of roll
fuller: The class list should call the roll number number, and each child shown with their number and name together, like 1. Ali. Old children keep their numbers and the children count stays at the top.

hurried: due date for each person i owe
fuller: Each khata entry should get a due date so I know when I need to pay someone back. The old entries can stay blank, and the amount and the people owe you total stay the same.

hurried: shop categories food cleaning other pls
fuller: The shopping list would be easier to scan if each item had a category of Food, Cleaning or Other, and the older items can take the default. The budget and the spent total at the top can stay as they are.

hurried: show walks on a calendar pls
fuller: The weekly goal of 4 walks and the list of walks are good, but I want to see the walks on a calendar too so I can spot the gaps. Keep the note box and the form as they are.
Could the symptom app show the average severity over the last 30 days as a number, with a trend of the scores under it? That would help me see whether the pain is getting better or worse.
The 9pm reminder to log coffee is too late for me, since I stop drinking it by then. Please take that reminder off, and keep the daily limit of 3 cups and the today count the same.

hurried: shower notes pls and no log button
fuller: I want each shower to have a note box I can fill in, and the Log shower button can go since I only use the form. The this week count and the day list can stay as they are.

hurried: this week net money line pls
fuller: The layout of the rickshaw page is good, and I want a faint This week line that takes the fares minus the fuel costs for the week, so I see what I keep. The today figure can stay the same.

hurried: make the sale price tag plum
fuller: The sale tag app should look plum to match the shop, so could the theme change to plum? Keep the price tag, the discount and the extra off boxes as they are.

hurried: add plus 2 and plus 3 buttons for each team
fuller: I want quick +2 and +3 buttons for both teams, so each basket can be scored with one tap. Keep the points box and the score totals at the top as they are.
The layout of the card scores is clear and I can see each player's total. Could the theme change to ocean? Keep the player names and the score totals exactly as they are.

hurried: remind me to add movies at 9 pm
fuller: I think of films to watch during the day and forget them by night, so a reminder at 21:00 saying Time to add movies I want to watch would help. The genre list and the seen ticks can stay the same.
This is the list of errands for my own week, and I want the name to say so. Could the app be renamed Little Errands? The priority choices and the open count can stay as they are.

hurried: show fuel costs by day pls
fuller: I want to see how much I spent on petrol each day of the last week, not only the cost per km. Could you add a bar for each day showing the fuel cost, and keep the litres and the km boxes as they are?

A 50 minute focus block with a Break time notice at the end would suit the work I do better than 25. Could you change the focus length to 50 minutes, and keep the rounds per day goal of 6 and the 5 minute break as they are.
The weight log for the cat and dog is simple and good, so could the look change to ink? Keep the kilogram box and the days since line as they are.

hurried: book pages this month and a daybar pls
fuller: I want to see the pages I have read this month and a bar for each of the last seven days, so I can tell how I am keeping up with my reading. Keep the form and the book list as they are.

hurried: change baby milk to ink theme
fuller: The layout of the milk log is clear, so keep it as it is. Could the whole look change to ink, since the bright mint is hard to read at night when I feed?
Five hours of coding a day is my new target, so please raise the daily coding goal to 5 hours. Keep the today total and the hours box the same. The rest of the app stays as it is.
I want the cheat meals app in ink colours now, the list and the log button can stay where they are. Please leave the week count and the reminder alone.
The prayers list with the times for Fajr, Zuhr, Asr, Maghrib and Isha is the core of it, so could the app be renamed Daily Prayers?
I want to see how many pages of homework I did on each of the last seven days as a bar, so I can see the busy days. The reminder at 8:00 and 20:00 can stay as it is.
The members get their monthly share from the start date, and the share has to go up to 10000 now from 5000. Keep the list of members and their turns as they are.
The count of care jobs this month is the most useful number on the page to me, so keep that, and change the theme to mint.
The quiz scores are fine, but I want the two point quick buttons gone, so the team scores are entered by typing the points. Keep the team names and the totals as they are.

hurried: bar of days gap per plant pls
fuller: The plant list is good, but I want to see a bar for each of the last seven days showing how many days each plant was left between waterings. The water button can stay where it is.
I skip meals at different times, so this log is for me to see. Could the look be slate instead of mint? The note box and the skip button can stay the same.
8 glasses a day is the goal I keep to, and I want the name to say that this is my own. Could the app be renamed Water Glass Buddy? The glasses per day setting and the picture can stay the same.
I want a daily goal for the floors I climb, with a bar that shows how many I have done today against it. Keep the floors list and the form for adding a climb as they are.

hurried: drop the days since book count
fuller: I do not need the days since the last entry count on my book list, because it makes me feel behind on reading. Please take that line off, and keep the pages and rating as they are.

hurried: add a medicine list to the vet book pls
fuller: I want a medicine list for each pet, with an Add medicine form, so I can keep track of what they were given. The cat and dog choices and the visit list can stay as they are.

The shop runs low on phone accessories every week, so a Saturday reminder at 9:00 saying Check your accessories would help me stock up before the weekend. Keep the low stock count and the Home, Work and Other kinds as they are.
I never write notes on my piano practice, so could you hide the note on each session? Any notes already saved will stay, just not showing. The 30 minute practice length can stay the same.
The category list with diapers, milk, medicine, clothes and toys is what I track, so could the app be renamed Baby costs Diary? Keep the amount and the monthly total as they are.

hurried: add a phone number to each family
fuller: Each aid family should get a phone number box, and the old families can stay blank. The members count and the village name can stay the same as they are.

hurried: undo button for cooked meals pls
fuller: I tap the cooked button by accident sometimes, so could an Undo button take off the last meal I marked as cooked today? The target of 5 and the circle can stay as they are.
Thirty-minute practice is too long for me, and I need the length of speaking to be 3 minutes. Could the look change to ink, with the daily goal of 8 left as it is?
I want to know how many days in a row I have been to the gym, so could a day streak line show under the visits count? The since the last visit line and the log visit button can stay.
I do the breathing part of my meditation and I do not need the rest timer, so please take the 5 minute rest timer out. The breathe length of 10 minutes and the done message can stay as they are.
The morning and evening readings of sugar are the core of this, and the name should feel more personal. Could the app be renamed Sugar Buddy? Keep the averages and the notes box as they are.
I want a heat chart of the last 70 days showing how many detox rules I kept each day, with the rules count as the top mark. Keep the today check list and the detox rules as they are.

hurried: car costs month to month and by category
fuller: I want to move between months with a month switch, and see the share by category and a list by day for whichever month I pick. Please take the old month only total and the old category share off the page.
The number of hugs I have counted is the thing I look at, so could the whole look change to ocean? Keep the target of 5 and the circle as they are.

hurried: quick coffee buttons for 1 and 2 cups
fuller: I usually have one or two cups of coffee, so quick buttons for 1 and 2 cups would save me typing each time. The today total and the 30 day average can stay as they are.
